Routed STA on r7f 6_final (eco pass2): every failing input path is pin -> ot_inhold HB2 (~80 ps) -> ot_ihdrv BUFx4f (~25) -> 3-4 hold-repair cells hold17xxx/29xxx (~125 ps) -> pin flop D; wire ~0 (flops FIRM at pins). Cause: pin-flop clock spread in the single 10,925-sink TritonCTS tree (R 460, boundary 447.7..506.9): late pin flops (TT clk ~482-504 vs input-min reference = median pin flop 431) need ~(L-Lmed)+25+th of hold pad -> 3-4 extra hold cells -> capture = pad 235 + setup + (R-L). SRAM prior-age comparisons register alongside existing captures; zero normal latency.
